products.introEn: The Small Andiamo gives a compact top-handle bag a softer rhythm through woven lambskin. Its silver-finish knot sits against black leather rather than a large printed emblem, while the sliding strap changes the way the bag sits on the body. The divided interior separates smaller belongings without making the exterior feel rigid. This is the choice in the edit for someone who enjoys tactile detail and a tidy daytime scale. The pictured reference uses silver-finish hardware; other colours and metal finishes should be checked as separate versions.
featuresEn: Black lambskin Intrecciato with a silver-finish knot detail
Sliding crossbody strap and magnetic fastening
Divided interior with one zipped pocket and two open pockets
products.stylingEn: Pair the woven surface with a plain wool coat or a cotton shirt. Carry it by the top handle for a compact outline, then use the sliding strap when you want both hands free.

products.introEn: The medium Rodeo introduces a deliberately relaxed outline to a top-handle format. Black calfskin folds around the front flap, and the aged-silver fastening adds a quieter metallic note than bright polished hardware. The removable shoulder strap offers another way to carry it, while side snaps and external pockets give the shape practical points of interest. Its appeal is the balance between an orderly handle and a body that looks less formal. Choose this version when a precise briefcase feels too strict but an unstructured tote feels too casual.
featuresEn: Smooth black calfskin with nappa lambskin lining
Turn-lock fastening and aged-silver hardware
Removable shoulder strap, front pocket and two rear flat pockets
products.stylingEn: Let the soft flap sit beside straight denim, a simple T-shirt and a long coat. Keep other accessories restrained so the folded silhouette remains the main detail.

products.priceLabel: U.S. retail listed-price reference, before tax
products.priceEvidence: Official U.S. HTML and ProductGroup variant offers identified reference AA1S06033I061999U and a USD price of 3050 on 2026-10-29.
products.imageRightsNote: Official product photograph for the specified reference; credit and source retained. No open reproduction licence is asserted.
products.introEn: Le Teckel stretches the shoulder bag into a long, narrow line. The smooth black calfskin and tubular handles keep the surface calm, allowing proportion to do most of the work. A double zip opens the low body, and a small removable mirror is kept inside. This medium version offers room for a phone, glasses and a wallet according to the house description. It is an expressive alternative to a square mini bag: compact in height, extended across the body, and especially clear against simple tailoring.
featuresEn: Elongated smooth-calfskin body with calfskin lining
Tubular handles, double zip and removable interior mirror
Medium format: 33 × 11 × 10 cm; made in Italy
products.stylingEn: Wear it with a close-fitting knit or an unbroken column of colour. The horizontal shape adds a useful counterpoint to long trousers and a vertical coat.

products.introEn: The Soft Margaux 15 brings a generous top-handle silhouette into the edit without relying on a large front logo. Matte grained calfskin gives the body texture, while belted side sections adjust its outline visually. Protective feet and an interior toggle are small practical details within a deliberately quiet design. The fifteen-inch format offers a different scale from the smaller shoulder bags here. Consider it for a restrained wardrobe of roomy coats and tailored separates, while checking the listed measurements against the things you normally carry.
featuresEn: Matte grained calfskin with cotton herringbone lining
Belted side gussets, protective feet and an interior toggle closure
15 × 11 × 9 in; black variant with palladium-plated hardware
products.stylingEn: Use it to balance a long coat and wide trousers, keeping the palette tonal. Its broader proportions work best when the rest of the outfit also has a little ease.
products.availabilityEn: The official U.S. page listed this black grained-calfskin variant at US$4,700 and marked it sold out when checked on 29 October 2026. This is a listed-price reference; confirm any later availability with The Row.

products.introEn: Wander rounds the small hobo bag into a soft loop, with gathered matelassé leather giving the surface its depth. Black nappa lambskin keeps the texture prominent, while gold-tone lettering offers a small point of contrast. The curved handle makes the bag readable as a single rounded form. A longer leather strap gives it another carrying option, and the zipped body is sized for everyday small essentials. This reference is a good contrast to the sharper Lady Dior or Galleria shapes already in the edit, bringing a more playful, compact profile.
featuresEn: Matelassé nappa lambskin with gold-tone lettering
Zip fastening, cotton satin lining and a 110 cm leather strap
20 × 17 × 6 cm; the house lists capacity for a phone and small wallet
products.stylingEn: Try it with a short cardigan, straight trousers or a simple slip dress. Let the leather texture provide interest and keep additional jewellery to a small number of pieces.

products.introEn: The large Amazona 180 gives the edit a spacious, relaxed option with a single rounded top handle. Soft calfskin allows the body to fold rather than hold a rigid box shape. Its open-looking arrangement is paired with a concealed fastening for the main compartment, so the visual ease is part of the design rather than a missing closure. Removable shoulder and crossbody straps
products.stylingEn: Carry it with an oversized shirt, relaxed trousers and flat shoes. The fuller silhouette suits an easy daytime wardrobe and adds movement beside clean, straight seams.

products.introEn: This Speedy Bandoulière 20 adds a lighter colour to the bag edit through Green Asnières Monogram Origine canvas. The rounded body, paired handles and double zip keep the small travel-bag character clear. Cowhide trim, a gold-tone padlock and a removable anniversary address tag introduce contrasting details, while a striped textile lining sits inside. It offers a different mood from the black leather bags around it: recognisable pattern, compact proportions and a softer green palette. The price refers specifically to M27530, rather than to every Speedy size or material.

Double zip, gold-tone padlock and removable anniversary address tag
20.5 × 13.5 × 12 cm with removable adjustable strap and twin handles
products.stylingEn: Use the pale green as a single colour accent with cream, washed denim or a brown coat. Carry it by the handles for a neat shape or attach the strap for an easier daytime look.
